"""
RAG Scene — StandingWave harmonics ladder
Feature: StandingWave (2D ParametricFunction-based wave)
"""
from manim import *
from manim_physics import *
import numpy as np


class StandingWaveHarmonicsScene(Scene):
    """Four harmonics of a standing wave arranged vertically with labels."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#050510"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Standing Wave Harmonics", font_size=38, color=WHITE)
        subtitle = Text("n = 1, 2, 3, 4  (fundamental + overtones)",
                        font_size=20, color="#94a3b8")
        header = VGroup(title, subtitle).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.15)
        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.7)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Build four standing waves ──────────────────────────────────────
        COLORS = ["#3b82f6", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444"]
        LABELS = ["n=1  fundamental",
                  "n=2  1st overtone",
                  "n=3  2nd overtone",
                  "n=4  3rd overtone"]

        waves = VGroup()
        labels_grp = VGroup()

        for i, (n, color, lbl) in enumerate(zip(range(1, 5), COLORS, LABELS)):
            w = StandingWave(n=n, length=4.5, period=1.2, amplitude=0.55)
            w.set_stroke(color=color, width=2.5)
            waves.add(w)

            lbl_mob = Text(lbl, font_size=18, color=color)
            labels_grp.add(lbl_mob)

        # Arrange waves in a vertical stack
        waves.arrange(DOWN, buff=0.65)
        waves.move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.2 + LEFT * 0.5)

        # Position labels to the right of each wave
        for w, lbl_mob in zip(waves, labels_grp):
            lbl_mob.next_to(w, RIGHT, buff=0.3)

        # ── Node count markers (vertical dashed lines at nodes) ───────────
        node_markers = VGroup()
        for i, w in enumerate(waves):
            n = i + 1
            x_center = w.get_center()[0]
            y_center = w.get_center()[1]
            x_start = x_center - 2.25
            for k in range(n + 1):
                x_node = x_start + k * (4.5 / n)
                tick = DashedLine(
                    [x_node, y_center - 0.18, 0],
                    [x_node, y_center + 0.18, 0],
                    color="#475569", stroke_width=1.2, dash_length=0.06
                )
                node_markers.add(tick)

        # ── Animate waves and labels appearing ───────────────────────────
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[Create(w) for w in waves], lag_ratio=0.25),
            run_time=1.8,
        )
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[Write(lbl) for lbl in labels_grp], lag_ratio=0.2),
            run_time=1.2,
        )
        self.play(FadeIn(node_markers, lag_ratio=0.05), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Start all waves oscillating ─────────────────────────────────
        for w in waves:
            w.start_wave()

        # Info box
        info_items = VGroup(
            Text("Nodes: fixed points (amplitude = 0)", font_size=15, color="#94a3b8"),
            Text("Antinodes: max displacement", font_size=15, color="#94a3b8"),
            Text("λₙ = 2L/n", font_size=15, color="#94a3b8"),
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.14, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        info_box = SurroundingRectangle(info_items, color="#1e293b",
                                         buff=0.2, corner_radius=0.1)
        info_panel = VGroup(info_box, info_items)
        info_panel.to_corner(DL, buff=0.45)

        self.play(FadeIn(info_panel, shift=RIGHT * 0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(4.0)

        for w in waves:
            w.stop_wave()

        closing = Text("All harmonics satisfy fixed boundary conditions",
                       font_size=17, color="#64748b")
        closing.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.25)
        self.play(Write(closing), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.8)

class RigidBodyDropScene(SpaceScene):
    """Several geometric shapes fall under gravity into a static containment box."""

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0a0a14"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.7)

        wall_l = Line([-4.0, -3.0, 0], [-4.0,  1.5, 0]).set_stroke(color="#475569", width=3)

        self.make_static_body(floor, wall_l, wall_r)

        # ── Falling shapes ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        circle1 = Circle(radius=0.35).set_fill("#3b82f6", opacity=1).shift(UP * 3.5 + LEFT * 2)
        circle2 = Circle(radius=0.28).set_fill("#10b981", opacity=1).shift(UP * 4.2 + RIGHT * 0.5)
        square  = Square(side_length=0.7).set_fill("#f59e0b", opacity=1).rotate(PI / 6).shift(UP * 5.0 + RIGHT * 2)
        triangle = Triangle().scale(0.5).set_fill("#ef4444", opacity=1).shift(UP * 4.5 + LEFT * 0.5)

        shapes = VGroup(circle1, circle2, square, triangle)

        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                *[DrawBorderThenFill(s) for s in shapes],
                lag_ratio=0.3,
            ),
            run_time=1.2,
        )
        self.wait(0.2)

        # ── Register as rigid bodies and let physics run ──────────────────
        self.make_rigid_body(circle1, circle2, square, triangle)

        # Add labels for shape types
        shape_labels = VGroup(
            Text("Circles", font_size=16, color="#3b82f6").to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.3).shift(UP * 1.5),
            Text("Square", font_size=16, color="#f59e0b").to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.3).shift(UP * 1.0),
            Text("Triangle", font_size=16, color="#ef4444").to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.3).shift(UP * 0.5),
        )
        self.play(FadeIn(shape_labels, lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=0.6)

        # Advance physics — shapes fall, bounce, settle
        self.wait(4.5)

        # ── Closing annotation ──────────────────────────────────────────
        closing = Text("Chipmunk2D physics engine via pymunk",
                       font_size=17, color="#64748b")
        closing.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.25)
        self.play(Write(closing), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.8)
